credits.title: Collision Course
credits.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

credits.title: The Remaining Sundays
credits.overview: August 1993. Dani has just turned 13. His family moves to a house in the suburbs. New school, new friends, new challenges. The beginning of a new life. credits.title: Eggnog
credits.overview: Celia doesn't want to celebrate her birthday. She is at that stage of life when it is better to think about other things. Her friends try to cheer her up with a strange gift.

credits.title: The Last Circus
credits.overview: A trapeze artist must decide between her lust for Sergio, the Happy Clown, or her affection for Javier, the Sad Clown, both of whom are deeply disturbed.

credits.title: Under the Stars
credits.overview: Selfish, opportunistic Benito returns to his home in Navarre when he learns that his father is dying. There, he reconnects with his younger brother Lalo, a metal sculptor who is emotionally needy. Benito also develops a surprising bond with Ainara, the young daughter of his brother's girlfriend, Nines.
